tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Ask AstraNL to find and coordinate a verified executor for a physical task in the Netherlands. Returns an ingress receipt at once and a case once planning found a path; the client pays the executor directly; AstraNL holds no money.

tools.name: check_task
tools.description: Current state of a task or ingress receipt from create_task, and who must act next. Returns only what is recorded; infers nothing.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: Machine-checkable evidence for an AstraNL task, action or receipt: the signed log events that mention it, each verified live, with a proof block stating what is verified, what is not, validity, status, limitations and next actions.

tools.name: verify_astranl
tools.description: Verify any AstraNL reference without a key. Returns two separate layers: integrity (payload hash, Ed25519 signature, Merkle inclusion, recomputed live) and claim (what exactly is attested, by whom, from which source, when, under which method, with which validity limits and current status VALID/EXPIR
